subject: general
question: Which of the following is a part of 'global commons'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Antarctica**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Global Commons **refers to **those areas **or **regions **of the **world **that **require common international governance and management**.
 
• These areas have been referred to as the **common heritage **of mankind and **include **the global or **world ocean **which is **governed by the UN Convention **on the **Law of the Sea**.
 
 
• **The Earth’s atmosphere **requires **collective endeavor **to deal with the **problem of pollution affecting the global atmosphere**.
 
• The **polar regions include **the **Antarctic and **Arctic; the **ocean floor **and lastly outer space, which is **governed by the Outer Space Treaty**.
 
 
 
• **These areas **are also **referred **to as the **international global resource domains**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Antarctica **is the **southernmost continent **and the **site of the South Pole**.
 
• It is **virtually uninhabited**.
 
• It is **fully an ice-covered **landmass.
 
• Most cruises to the continent visit the Antarctic Peninsula, which stretches toward South America.
